messages:
zoe: filing this thread after a brief but noisy cross-region TLS/route spike this morning ~09:14 UTC. saw client retries and 5xxs. collecting owners and follow-ups here.
hamed: noticed a routing reconcile at 09:10 that briefly referenced pool-id legacy-42. concurrent spikes in TLS handshake errors with `server name mismatch`.
riley: alerted and pinned egress to stable pool at 09:18; drained legacy-42 and forced cert reloads. metrics normalized by ~09:33.
polly: quick pcap shows RSTs & `handshake_failure` from a small subset of eu nodes; cert CNs reported as edge-old.local for those nodes.
zoe: immediate mitigations summary: pin, drain, reload. next we need owners for cleanup, telemetry, and runbook changes.
hamed: triage action items (owner / ETA):
  - hamed -> remove legacy-42 references from global routing map + add deny rule (ETA 2026-04-07)
  - riley -> add post-rollout SNI+cert consistency check to control-plane job (ETA 2026-03-31)
  - polly -> add SNI-mismatch metric + alert (ETA 2026-03-29)
  - zoe -> update runbook with explicit pin/drain/reload checklist and smoke commands (ETA 2026-03-27)
ops-bot: created ticket RH-4510 and assigned hamed,riley,polly,zoe; link: internal/rh/4510
hamed: plan: split RH-4510 into RH-4510a (routing cleanup) and RH-4510b (control-plane probe). will open PRs and post links.
polly: telemetry note: recommend alert when SNI-mismatch >=0.3% for 5m across cross-region egress. I'll PR alert rule.
riley: smoke-check snippet I'll add to pipeline PR: `openssl s_client -connect edge.eu:443 -servername api.redwood.example </dev/null | grep -i "Subject"`
zoe: long-term proposals: short suppress window on large route sweeps, canary TLS probes that validate SANs, and client SDK retry jitter to reduce amplification.
ops-bot: RH-4510 status=open; next_review=2026-03-29T14:00:00Z.
zoe: owners please post short updates here with prefix "RH-4510" so ops-bot picks them up. we'll close RH-4510 when routing cleanup PRs merged, probe live, and SNI alerting in place.
